title: Exact bicomplex of successive free two-step covers
statement: Let $A$ be a commutative ring and $M^\bullet$ a cochain complex of $A$-modules [def-pc-cochain-complex-modules]. There exist a bicomplex $K^{p,q}$ with commuting horizontal and vertical differentials, its direct-sum total complex $T^n=\bigoplus_{p+q=n}K^{p,q}$ with differential $d_h+(-1)^p d_v$, a map $a:K^{0,\bullet}\to M^\bullet$, and a map $\epsilon:T^\bullet\to M^\bullet$ such that: (1) every column $p>0$ is zero; (2) $\epsilon$ restricts to $a$ on column zero and to zero on every negative column; (3) for every $q$, the augmented row $\cdots\to K^{-2,q}\to K^{-1,q}\to K^{0,q}\xrightarrow{a}M^q\to0$ is exact, and the augmented row of vertical cocycles is exact as well; (4) for every $p\le0$, there is a degreewise split short exact sequence of complexes $0\to U_p^\bullet\to B_p^\bullet\to V_p^\bullet\to0$, an isomorphism $B_p^\bullet\cong K^{p,\bullet}$, and decompositions of $U_p^\bullet,V_p^\bullet$ as direct sums indexed by sets of the same universe as $A$, each summand being $A$ concentrated in one integer degree. No assertion of quasi-isomorphism or of a filtration of $T$ is made.

proof.text: Apply [lem-pc-derived-free-cover-columns] to obtain K and a, zero positive columns, exact augmented rows on terms and cycles, and the split free two-step data on columns.

Exactness of the row at column zero implies K.d(-1,0) followed by a is zero, by applying the exact-pair identity in every module degree. Define each degree of epsilon by totalDesc: its components are a on column zero (transported along 0+q=n), and zero otherwise. Check the cochain-map identity by total.hom_ext and the formulas for the two total differentials. For column zero, K.d(0,1)=0 since column one is zero and the vertical sign is one, so the identity is a.comm. For column -1 the horizontal term is zero by the exact-pair identity and the vertical term is zero by its column; for every other nonzero column both components vanish. The totalDesc inclusion identity gives both required restrictions of epsilon. Combine these with the column theorem conclusions.

lean.statement: theorem exists_freeCoverBicomplex {A : Type u} [CommRing A] (M : CochainComplex (ModuleCat.{u} A) ℤ) : ∃ K : HomologicalComplex₂ (ModuleCat.{u} A) (ComplexShape.up ℤ) (ComplexShape.up ℤ), ∃ (ε : K.total (ComplexShape.up ℤ) ⟶ M) (a : K.X 0 ⟶ M), (∀ p : ℤ, 0 < p → IsZero (K.X p)) ∧ (∀ q : ℤ, K.ιTotal (ComplexShape.up ℤ) 0 q q (by simp) ≫ ε.f q = a.f q) ∧ (∀ (p q n : ℤ) (hp : p < 0) (h : ComplexShape.π (ComplexShape.up ℤ) (ComplexShape.up ℤ) (ComplexShape.up ℤ) (p, q) = n), K.ιTotal (ComplexShape.up ℤ) p q n h ≫ ε.f n = 0) ∧ (∀ (p q : ℤ), p < -1 → Function.Exact ((K.d p (p + 1)).f q).hom ((K.d (p + 1) (p + 2)).f q).hom) ∧ (∀ q : ℤ, Function.Exact ((K.d (-1) 0).f q).hom (a.f q).hom) ∧ (∀ q : ℤ, Function.Surjective (a.f q).hom) ∧ (∀ (p q : ℤ), p < -1 → Function.Exact (HomologicalComplex.cyclesMap (K.d p (p + 1)) q).hom (HomologicalComplex.cyclesMap (K.d (p + 1) (p + 2)) q).hom) ∧ (∀ q : ℤ, Function.Exact (HomologicalComplex.cyclesMap (K.d (-1) 0) q).hom (HomologicalComplex.cyclesMap a q).hom) ∧ (∀ q : ℤ, Function.Surjective (HomologicalComplex.cyclesMap a q).hom) ∧ (∀ p : ℤ, p ≤ 0 → ∃ S : ShortComplex (CochainComplex (ModuleCat.{u} A) ℤ), Nonempty (S.X₂ ≅ K.X p) ∧ S.ShortExact ∧ (∀ k : ℤ, Nonempty (S.map (HomologicalComplex.eval (ModuleCat.{u} A) (ComplexShape.up ℤ) k)).Splitting) ∧ ∃ (I₁ I₃ : Type u) (d₁ : I₁ → ℤ) (d₃ : I₃ → ℤ), Nonempty (S.X₁ ≅ ∐ (fun i : I₁ ↦ (HomologicalComplex.single (ModuleCat.{u} A) (ComplexShape.up ℤ) (d₁ i)).obj (ModuleCat.of A A))) ∧ Nonempty (S.X₃ ≅ ∐ (fun i : I₃ ↦ (HomologicalComplex.single (ModuleCat.{u} A) (ComplexShape.up ℤ) (d₃ i)).obj (ModuleCat.of A A))))
